groups.root_cause: The shell quote/heredoc stripping removes command substitutions inside double-quoted strings and unquoted heredocs, even though the shell runs them, so the signal commands inside are never checked.
The JavaScript string stripping deletes template literal interpolations, which run as code, so signal calls inside them are never checked.
Inline eval detection only recognizes the space-separated option form and misses the standard equals form (--eval=...).
Wrapping the Codex CLI in an outer Seatbelt sandbox blocks the runtime it needs, including writes to its state directory, so tool-enabled agents can't initialize or start.
